advancement.deep_aether.brass_dungeon.de:
Defeat the electrum boss
§b- Deep Aether -
deep_aether.brass_treasure_chest_locked: This Treasure Chest must be unlocked with a Electrum Key.
lore.block.deep_aether.combiner: Used to create an assortment of items by combining Golden Amber, Frozen Goldenleaf Berries, and a third item of choice. Can be found in Electrum Dungeons, or made for yourself!
lore.block.deep_aether.holystone_pillar: A pillar variant of Holystone. Can be found primarily in Electrum Dungeons, and is very good for decoration.
lore.block.deep_aether.light_nimbus_pill: The light version of Nimbus Pillars, also found in Electrum Dungeons.
lore.block.deep_aether.light_nimbus_ston: The light version of Nimbus Stone, also found in Electrum Dungeons.
lore.block.deep_aether.nimbus_pillar: One of the unique stones of the Electrum Dungeon. This pillar can be mined and used as a decorative block.
lore.block.deep_aether.nimbus_stone: One of the unique stones of the Electrum Dungeon. This stone can be mined and used as a decorative block.
